name: Kikyou
source:
A kind-hearted woman who supports Kaoru and has decided to live with the Kamiki family.

She prefers Kaoru's straightforward personality over Serahime's.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
